selection_reason: Default html:false configuration -> if changed to true by admin -> allows raw HTML in markdown rendering
source_summary: Configuration comes from admin settings via meta.settings.get('markdown') with defaults including 'html': false
sink_summary: Parser configuration flows to Remarkable markdown parser which renders user content via markdownify hook
guard_summary: Default configuration sets html:false; admin can change via settings but requires admin privileges
risk_pattern: Default html:false prevents raw HTML in markdown; if admin enables html:true, user-submitted markdown can contain arbitrary HTML leading to XSS
enclosing_conditions: Admin settings override mechanism in meta.settings.get callback
context_summary: The 'html' configuration controls whether Remarkable parser allows raw HTML in markdown. Default false prevents XSS; if admin enables, user content can execute arbitrary HTML/JS.
unresolved_facts: Specific Remarkable version and its exact HTML handling behavior
Whether NodeBB has additional HTML sanitization after markdown parsing

hypotheses.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
hypotheses.fit_reason: Admin configuration enables raw HTML in markdown parser, leading to XSS when user content contains HTML/JS. Stage-2 evidence shows html:false default prevents XSS; enabling it bypasses neutralization.

hypotheses.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
hypotheses.fit_reason: Markdown rendering with html:true passes raw HTML without proper encoding/escaping, resulting in stored XSS via user-submitted markdown.

Admin-only configuration option controls dangerous feature (raw HTML). If admin misconfigures or is compromised, XSS impact occurs. Relates to improper access control over security-critical configuration.
Default html:false is a protection mechanism; admin can disable it via configuration, leading to XSS protection failure. Similar to insecure Helmet configuration but for markdown parser.
